purpose: Teach: 尺度/原題/考案/多種/年版/義務づけ/失格/事業主

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、評価尺度を明確にしろ
lines.en: Make sure our evaluation criteria are clear.
lines.style: Commanding, clipped delivery. No negotiation. Eyes forward. Each word lands with weight. Steady, authoritative breath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品の原題を変更します
lines.en: Understood. We'll revise the product naming.
lines.style: Immediate, compliant. Crisp acknowledgment. A small pause to absorb the instruction before responding. Professional, respectful register throughout.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、若手社員が考案した企画を採用しろ
lines.en: Adopt the proposals our younger staff have come up with.
lines.style: Direct instruction, no softening. Matter-of-fact tone. Slight emphasis on 「採用」 — this is a decision, not a suggestion. Measured pace.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。多種の業務を効率化しております
lines.en: Understood. We're working to streamline our various operations.
lines.style: Steady, informative. Not defensive — just reporting progress. Even tone. A hint of confidence in 「効率化」 without overstatement.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、年版の報告書をしっかり作成しろ
lines.en: Make sure the annual report is prepared thoroughly.
lines.style: Deliberate emphasis on carefulness. Not harsh, but firm. The word 「しっかり」 carries the weight here. Slightly slower pace on the key phrase.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員に研修参加を義務づける方針です
lines.en: Understood. We're making training attendance mandatory for all staff.
lines.style: Clear, systematic. Delivering a concrete policy decision. Neutral, professional tone. No apology, no excess — just facts.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、コンプライアンス違反は失格事由だ
lines.en: Compliance violations are grounds for dismissal.
lines.style: Grave, absolute. Lower register. The tone of someone setting a boundary that won't move. No room for interpretation. Stillness underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新規事業主との契約を進めております
lines.en: Understood. We're moving forward with contracts for our new business partners.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Assured, professional close. Slightly warmer than before — the work is being done correctly. Settling tone.
